standard.summary: LoftQ 首版使用 fake-quant/dequant 权重残差初始化
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: The first LoftQ version initialises from a fake-quant/dequant weight residual
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: LoftQ 首版使用 fake-quant/dequant 权重残差初始化；不是持久 4bit base runtime。

advanced_en.principle: LoftQ v1 uses fake-quant/dequant weight-residual initialization; it is not a persistent 4-bit base runtime.
